summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for $3,136,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due June 30, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the KRE ETF and S&P 500 Index. The notes are part of its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, unsecured and subject to issuer credit risk. Terms include quarterly contingent coupons, autocall feature from December 2026, and barrier protection at maturity. This is an ordinary structured note offering under a shelf registration; no special-situation event is present.
